user.description: Create a **Push** monitor in Uptime Kuma and paste its push URL. Set the monitor's heartbeat interval in Uptime Kuma to at least the push interval below.

data_description.push_url: For example https://kuma.example.com/api/push/abc123. Any query string is ignored.

error.invalid_url: Not a valid Uptime Kuma push URL (expected …/api/push/TOKEN).
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Uptime Kuma.
error.rejected: Uptime Kuma rejected the push. Check the token and that the monitor is active.

abort.already_configured: This push URL is already configured.
